howto.what: 装上后，当你给一个概念，Claude 会把它做成杂志专题风格的视觉笔记：按“真问题→失败→转折→顿悟→命名”叙事，用六种版式和四种字体，生成单文件 HTML 长图（1080px 宽）。
howto.when: 当你要求把一个概念做成杂志风视觉笔记，或给出概念并希望按“问题→失败→转折→顿悟→命名”叙事输出时。

say.text: 把“涌现”做成编辑式视觉笔记。
say.note: 会按六段叙事输出 HTML 长图。

say.text: 为“还原论”做一份杂志探案档案。
say.note: 会生成含失败与转折的视觉笔记。

say.text: 用这个技能把“范式转移”画成六段式笔记。
say.note: 输出含六种版式的静态长图。

howto.what_en: After installation, when given a concept, Claude turns it into a magazine-style visual note: narrative 'real problem → failure → turn → insight → naming', using six layouts and four font families, output as a single-file HTML long image (1080px wide).
howto.when_en: When the user asks to turn a concept into a magazine-style visual note, or provides a concept and wants the narrative from problem to naming output.

say_en.note: Claude will output a six-section HTML long image.
It will generate a visual note with failures and a turning point.

say_en.text: Use this skill to draw 'paradigm shift' as a six-part note.
say_en.note: Output is a static page with six layouts.
